t2.title: Fast fashion be discouraged to protect the environment
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should fast fashion be discouraged to protect the environment?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Internet Access: From Luxury to Necessity

Twenty years ago, home internet was a luxury. Today, it's arguably as essential as electricity or water. Here's why.

Firstly, remote work has become mainstream. Without reliable internet, millions cannot perform their jobs. Video conferencing, cloud computing, and digital collaboration require stable, fast connections.

Moreover, education increasingly depends on internet access. Students need connectivity for homework, research, and online learning platforms. The pandemic exposed how digital divides create educational inequality.

Additionally, essential services are moving online – banking, healthcare appointments, government services, and job applications. Those without internet access are effectively excluded from modern society.

However, high-speed internet remains unaffordable or unavailable for many, particularly in rural areas.

Ultimately, reliable internet should be treated as essential infrastructure. Governments must work to ensure universal access at affordable prices.

Is internet a right or a privilege in your view?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi FastNet,

Internet good. Fast. Installation ok. More TV?

Bye
t2.sampleA2:
Dear FastNet,

The internet is good, and it is fast. The installation was easy, and the man was nice. But I want more channels on the TV because I like to watch movies. Also, the price is a little high, but it is okay because the internet is fast.

Thank you,

Javohir Salimov
t2.sampleB1:
Dear FastNet Customer Support,

Thank you for your welcome message. I am mostly happy with the new internet service. The speed is definitely better than my old provider, which is good. The installation was quite smooth, and the engineer was helpful.

However, I think you could improve the customer service. I tried to call about a billing question, and I had to wait a long time on the phone. Also, it would be good if you offered a discount for loyal customers.

In terms of additional services, maybe you could offer a package with a streaming service like Netflix or Amazon Prime. Many people use these services, and it would be convenient.

Overall, I am satisfied, but there is room for improvement.

Sincerely,
Javohir Salimov
t2.sampleB2: Great topic — this is something I feel really strongly about! For me, fast fashion should definitely be discouraged. The environmental cost is enormous, and most people simply do not realise it. Cheap clothes are churned out at an incredible pace, while the factories behind them pump out tonnes of carbon and waste. On top of that, many garments are made from synthetic fabrics that never really break down, so they end up piling up in landfill. In fact, the industry is said to generate more emissions than international flights and shipping combined. The bigger issue, in my opinion, is our throwaway mindset. We buy something, wear it once or twice, then chuck it out the moment a new trend comes along. If brands were pushed to slow down and use sustainable materials, it would make a real difference. That said, I do not think we should ban it outright — plenty of people rely on affordable clothing. The real answer is educating shoppers and encouraging them to buy less but better. What do you all think? Has anyone here actually managed to cut back on fast fashion? I would love to hear your tips.
t2.uzSample:
Internetga kirish: Hashamatdan Zaruratga

Yigirma yil oldin uy interneti hashamat edi. Bugungi kunda, ehtimol, u elektr yoki suv kabi zarurdir. Buning sababi quyidagicha.

Birinchidan, masofaviy ish asosiy oqimga aylandi. Ishonchli internetsiz millionlab odamlar o'z ishlarini bajara olmaydi. Video konferensiya, bulutli hisoblash va raqamli hamkorlik barqaror, tezkor ulanishlarni talab qiladi.

Bundan tashqari, ta'lim tobora internetga kirishga bog'liq. Talabalarga uy vazifalari, tadqiqotlar va onlayn ta'lim platformalari uchun ulanish kerak. Pandemiya raqamli tafovutlar ta'limdagi tengsizlikni qanday yaratishini ko'rsatdi.

Bundan tashqari, muhim xizmatlar onlaynga o'tmoqda - bank ishi, sog'liqni saqlash uchrashuvlari, davlat xizmatlari va ishga ariza berish. Internetga kirish imkoniyati bo'lmaganlar zamonaviy jamiyatdan samarali ravishda chetlashtirilgan.

Biroq, yuqori tezlikdagi internet ko'pchilik uchun, ayniqsa qishloq joylarda, qimmat yoki mavjud emas.

Oxir oqibat, ishonchli internet muhim infratuzilma sifatida ko'rib chiqilishi kerak. Hukumatlar hamyonbop narxlarda universal kirishni ta'minlash uchun ishlashi kerak.

Sizningcha, internet huquqmi yoki imtiyozmi?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom FastNet,

Internet yaxshi. Tez. O'rnatish yaxshi. Ko'proq TV?

Xayr
t2.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli FastNet,

Internet yaxshi va u tez. O'rnatish oson bo'ldi va odam yaxshi edi. Lekin men televizorda ko'proq kanallar bo'lishini xohlayman, chunki men kino ko'rishni yaxshi ko'raman. Shuningdek, narx biroz qimmat, lekin bu yaxshi, chunki internet tez.

Rahmat,

Javohir Salimov
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli FastNet mijozlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash xizmati,

Xush kelibsiz xabaringiz uchun rahmat. Men asosan yangi internet xizmatidan mamnunman. Tezlik, albatta, eski provayderimdan yaxshiroq, bu yaxshi. O'rnatish juda muammosiz bo'ldi va muhandis yordam berdi.

Biroq, menimcha, siz mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishni yaxshilashingiz mumkin. Men hisob-kitob bo'yicha savol haqida qo'ng'iroq qilishga harakat qildim va telefonda uzoq vaqt kutishimga to'g'ri keldi. Shuningdek, sodiq mijozlar uchun chegirma taklif qilsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi.

Qo'shimcha xizmatlar nuqtai nazaridan, ehtimol siz Netflix yoki Amazon Prime kabi striming xizmati bilan paket taklif qilishingiz mumkin. Ko'p odamlar ushbu xizmatlardan foydalanadilar va bu qulay bo'lardi.

Umuman olganda, men qoniqdim, lekin yaxshilanish uchun imkoniyat bor.

Hurmat bilan,
Javohir Salimov
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli FastNet mijozlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash xizmati,

Xush kelibsiz xatingiz uchun rahmat. Umuman olganda, men FastNet Broadband-ga o'tishdan juda mamnunman. Reklama qilingan tezliklar asosan bajarildi, bu mening oldingi provayderimga nisbatan sezilarli yaxshilanishni anglatadi. O'rnatish jarayoni nisbatan muammosiz kechdi, garchi dastlabki jadval mening tomondan biroz moslashuvchanlikni talab qildi.

Xizmatni yaxshilash bo'yicha potentsial takliflarga kelsak, menimcha, yanada mustahkam onlayn qo'llab-quvvatlash portali foydali bo'ladi. Telefon orqali qo'llab-quvvatlash yetarli bo'lsa-da, keng qamrovli FAQ bo'limi va muammolarni bartaraf etish bo'yicha qo'llanmalar onlayn rejimda mavjud bo'lishi ko'plab foydalanuvchilar uchun muammolarni hal qilishni soddalashtiradi. Bundan tashqari, tarmoqli kengligi taqsimoti bo'yicha ko'proq moslashuvchanlikka ega bo'lgan bosqichma-bosqich ma'lumotlar rejalari foydalanuvchilarning kengroq doirasini qondirishi mumkin.

Potentsial o'rganish uchun bir soha - bu aqlli uy texnologiyasini integratsiya qilish. FastNet keng polosali aloqasini aqlli uy xavfsizlik tizimlari yoki avtomatlashtirilgan uyni boshqarish yechimlari bilan birlashtirish texnologiyaga qiziquvchi mijozlar uchun jozibali qiymat taklifini yaratishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, men hozirgacha ko'rsatilgan xizmatdan umuman mamnunman. Onlayn qo'llab-quvvatlashni kuchaytirishga va innovatsion xizmat integratsiyalarini o'rganishga e'tibor qaratgan holda, FastNet yetakchi keng polosali aloqa provayderi sifatidagi o'rnini yanada mustahkamlashi mumkin.

Hurmat bilan,
Javohir Salimov

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the internet service provider. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear FastNet Customer Support,

Thank you for welcoming me as a new customer. I am pleased to share my initial feedback.

Firstly, the connection speed has been excellent. Streaming and video calls now work flawlessly, which has significantly improved my work-from-home experience.

However, the installation process was somewhat delayed. The technician arrived two hours late without prior notice. Better appointment scheduling would be appreciated.

Additionally, offering a mobile app to monitor data usage and manage my account would be extremely convenient.

Furthermore, providing bundle deals with TV streaming services could attract more customers.

Thank you for your reliable service.

Best regards,
A Satisfied Customer
t12.sampleA1:
Hi FastNet,
Internet is good. Fast!
Installation... ok. Man late.
Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Hello FastNet,
I like the internet. It is very fast and I can watch videos.
But the man was late. He came at 3 o'clock, not 1 o'clock.
I want TV with the internet, because I like to watch TV.
Thank you.
t12.sampleB1:
Dear FastNet Customer Support,
Thank you for your email. I am writing to give you some feedback about your service.
The internet speed is very good. I am happy with that. However, the installation was not very good. The man who came to my house was late. He didn't call to say he was late, and I had to wait a long time.
I think it would be good if you had a better system for appointments. Also, I would like to see you offer TV and internet together as a package. This would be very useful for me.
Thank you for listening to my feedback.
Sincerely,
A New Customer
t12.sampleB2: Dear FastNet Customer Support, Thank you for your welcome message. Having recently switched from my previous provider, I would like to share my early impressions. On the whole, I have been really pleased. The connection speed is excellent, and streaming and video calls now run without a hitch, which has made working from home far easier. The installation, however, did not go entirely smoothly. The technician turned up nearly two hours late with no prior warning, which was rather frustrating. I would suggest keeping customers better informed about scheduling. Looking ahead, I think a mobile app for tracking data usage and managing payments would be a great addition. Bundle deals with popular streaming services would also be worth considering. Overall, I am happy with the service and hope these suggestions prove useful. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova

Biroq, o'rnatish jarayoni biroz kechikdi. Texnik xodim oldindan ogohlantirmasdan ikki soat kechga qoldi. Uchrashuvlarni yaxshiroq rejalashtirish yaxshi bo'lardi.

Bundan tashqari, ma'lumotlardan foydalanishni kuzatish va hisobimni boshqarish uchun mobil ilovani taklif qilish juda qulay bo'lardi.

Qolaversa, TV striming xizmatlari bilan to'plamli takliflarni taqdim etish ko'proq mijozlarni jalb qilishi mumkin.

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Qoniqish hosil qilgan mijoz

Hurmatli FastNet mijozlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash xizmati,

Men FastNet keng polosali internetining yangi mijoz sifatidagi so'nggi tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, internet tezligi va ishonchliligidan mamnunman, bu avvalgi provayderimga nisbatan sezilarli yaxshilanish bo'ldi.

Biroq, o'rnatish jarayoni ba'zi qiyinchiliklarni keltirib chiqardi. Texnik xodim belgilangan vaqtdan taxminan bir soat kechikib keldi va kechikish haqida oldindan xabar berish yetarli emas edi. Texnik xodim oxir-oqibat professional va samarali bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, jadvalni yaxshilash va aloqani kuchaytirish mijozlar tajribasini yaxshilaydi.

Qo'shimcha xizmatlar nuqtai nazaridan, hisobni boshqarish, ma'lumotlardan foydalanishni kuzatish va nosozliklarni bartaraf etish uchun keng qamrovli onlayn portal yoki mobil ilova taklif qilish qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'ladi deb o'ylayman. Bundan tashqari, ommabop striming xizmatlari bilan hamkorlik qilib, to'plam paketlarini taklif qilish potentsial mijozlar uchun jozibali rag'bat bo'lishi mumkin.

Fikr-mulohazalarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur. FastNet keng polosali interneti bilan ijobiy tajribam davom etishiga umid qilaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Qadrdon mijoz
